up: For the assay with identifier CHEMBL1613838, retrieve the following for all tested compounds: 1) the exact activity value (standard_value), the associated relation (standard_relation), the activity type (standard_type), and the units (standard_units) from the activities table; 2) the canonical SMILES structure from the compound_structures table. Return all distinct records.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.standard_value, a.standard_relation, a.standard_type, a.standard_units, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613838'
